title: fix(rest): the one-request record page accepts a related list keyed by a user field
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Fixes #29946

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 一次请求的记录页路由 `POST /data/:object/:id/page` 的关联列表检查,不再用路由里私有的 `lookup`/`master_detail` 名单加裸读 `reference`,改问 spec 的唯一目标裁判 `referenceTargetOf`(引擎的 `$expand` 和删除级联读的就是它)。`user` 字段按类型指向 `sys_user`,所以 `sys_user` 页上按 owner/assignee 的关联列表重新返回 200 和行。
- **为什么改:** 18.3.0 回归(duly#185):路由由 #27713 新建,18.2.0 没有这个文件,控制台按普通列表读逐个取关联列表,不做类型检查;18.3.0 起整页打开报 400 `invalid_relationship`,而该列表自己的行查询 `{ [field]: id }` 本可以照常回答。
- **风险与回滚:** 只放宽回 18.2.0 的可读范围,不引用页对象的字段仍是定位 400(别的对象页上的 `user`、指向别处的 `lookup`、别的对象上的 `tree`、读不了的 `reference`);错误文案改为列出四种类型。`@objectstack/rest` patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts` 的 `referenceOf` 与 `invalid_relationship` 一处;测试 `record-page-routes.test.ts` 的 `[#29946]` describe。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/record-page-routes.test.ts`,预期 `32 passed`。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位评审并落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/rest`, `record-page-routes.ts`.** The related-list check drops the route's private `RELATIONSHIP_TYPES` set (`lookup`, `master_detail`) and its raw `reference` read. `referenceOf` now asks the spec's one arbiter, `referenceTargetOf` from `@objectstack/spec/data` (the reference value types `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`, `tree`; a `user` field's target is fixed to `sys_user` by its type, whether or not its carrier spells it). That is the same judgement the engine's `$expand` gate and referential delete walk read (`engine.ts` `deleteWalkTargetOf` answers `referenceTargetOf` for a `user` field), so the route and the related list's row query (`{ [field]: id }`, or `$contains` on a multi-valued field) cannot disagree about which fields relate a child to its parent.
- An unreadable `reference` carrier (object- or array-valued, never parsed) throws inside the arbiter. The route catches that and keeps the located `400 invalid_relationship` it answered before, not a thrown 500.
- The refusal message names the four kinds: `'<field>' on '<child>' is not a lookup, master-detail, user or tree field that references '<object>'.` Code, status and location are unchanged.
- **Reading, `tree`:** it comes with the arbiter. A `tree` field relates a child to its own object only (its reference is self-referential by contract), and the row query follows it the same way, so a related list of a record's children on its own page is now accepted; a `tree` on another object's page is still refused. There is no separate `owner` field type in `FieldType` (measured `field.zod.ts`), so nothing else changes.
- Nothing new is exported. The `url` action at `record_header` from the card's second paragraph is a separate `domain:ui` card and is not touched.

## Why

Card #29946, from duly#185: a record page on `sys_user` with a related list of `duly_task` keyed by `owner` (a `Field.user`) answered `400 VALIDATION_FAILED: 'owner' on 'duly_task' is not a lookup or master-detail field that references 'sys_user'.` on 18.3.0, so the console's full-page record view showed "could not load this record".

**Where it came from:** `record-page-routes.ts` did not exist at `@objectstack/rest@18.2.0` (the contents API answers 404 at that tag). #27713 (`0027c4a2b8`, 2026-10-30) created the route with `RELATIONSHIP_TYPES = new Set(['lookup', 'master_detail'])` and the raw `reference` read; #28682 and #28991 kept the check as it was. On 18.2.0 the console read each related list through the ordinary list read of the child filtered by the field, which applies no relationship-type check, so the page rendered.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Verification

- `record-page-routes.test.ts`, new `[#29946]` describe through the real route handler:
  - a related list on `sys_user` keyed by a bare `{ type: 'user' }` field, a `user` field with `reference: 'sys_user'`, and a multi-valued `user` field answers 200 with each list's rows; the reads are `{ owner: 'u9' }`, `{ assignee: 'u9' }`, `{ reviewers: { $contains: 'u9' } }`;
  - a `user` field on the `account` page is still `400` `invalid_relationship` at `related.0.field`, with the exact new message, and nothing is read;
  - a `lookup` relates only to its own reference, and a `tree` only to its own object;
  - an unreadable `reference` carrier is the located 400, not a 500.
  - The existing pin (`title`, `owner` as a lookup to another object, `nope` are all 400) is unchanged and green.
- **Ablations**, each run once and restored:
  1. Old check back (`!new Set(['lookup','master_detail']).has(def.type) || …`): 2 failed, `a related list on sys_user keyed by a user field answers 200 …` and `a lookup keeps relating only to its own reference, and a tree to its own object`, both `AssertionError: expected 400 to be 200`.
  2. Accept any `user` field regardless of target (`… && def.type !== 'user'`): 1 failed, `a user field on a page that is not sys_user is still a located 400 …`, `AssertionError: expected 200 to be 400`.
  3. Restored: 32 passed.
- `@objectstack/rest^...` closure build (26 tasks): exit 0. `@objectstack/rest` `pnpm test`: 383 files, 7159 passed / 332 skipped, exit 0. `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at the head rebased on `origin/main` `40fa4335`: 59 derived commands, 58 exit 0, 1 exit 3 (prerequisite, nothing measured): `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads a whole-repo build and only the rest closure was built; it reads no path this diff touches. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its fixture commit `621a4876` was not in the shallow clone) and is exit 0 (48 cases) after fetching that commit. `dispatch-gates --ran`: `✓ 59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. CI's Build Core and type-check lanes are the jobs the tool lists as not measurable locally.
- Serial: no open PR edits `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts` (scanned every open PR's file list before opening).
- Not run locally: the `record-page.dogfood.test.ts` suite (the dogfood regression gate runs on `main`'s push battery).
